chunks: From him, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Righteousness and good manners build the houses (households) and increase the life-spans.

key_terms.الْبِرُّ: Righteousness, piety, or goodness in action
key_terms.حُسْنُ الْخُلُقِ: Good manners, excellent character, or good conduct

ai.seo_question: What are the benefits of good manners and righteousness according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) links moral excellence to both material stability and physical longevity, reflecting the Shia understanding that inner virtue manifests in external blessings. This narration underscores the holistic impact of husn al-khu'lq, suggesting that ethical conduct not only enriches the home but also extends life, a concept supported by the principle of 'increase in sustenance' for the righteous.
